milestoneTitle: M4: 修 M2 newFindings (PG source provenance + warnIfDualPopulated probe cost)
milestoneAcceptance: M4.S1: M4 ledger 落地,范围与 M3 ledger 互不重叠 (不涉及 M1 10-entry recheck,后者仍是 owner decision)
M4.S2: PG schema 加 source 列 (text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'native'),加 imported_at timestamptz,迁移安全可重入 (idempotent IF NOT EXISTS)
M4.S3: PG migrator 写 tasks 时携带 source / imported_at,axi-todo-import-postgres.mjs 写源为 'import-postgres'

M4.S4: warnIfDualPopulated 默认只在 chosenKind 实际可能产生对偶写入时探测对侧 (JSON-only chosen → skip PG probe unless AXI_TODO_DUAL_PROBE=1;PG-only chosen → skip JSON probe symmetrically);probe 调用方 (cli / daemon / mcp) 在 store-only boot 路径下不付出 PG connect 成本
M4.S5: parity 测试:JSON task 的 source / imported_at 字段迁移到 PG 后保留;warnIfDualPopulated 在 JSON-only / PG-only / both-populated 三种场景下 IO 调用次数符合预期 (mocks 计数)
M4.S6: 全测试套件全绿,Swift smoke 不变;Lore commits 落地;M4 ledger close

subTasks.evidence: tools/axi-todo/.m1-snapshot/ledger/m4-entries.json initially committed in commit a0fb696; outOfScopeButFlagged locks down 5 items (M1 10-entry recheck, Swift→PG bridge, non-tasks collections, warnIfDualPopulated rewrite, PG→JSON reverse sync)

tools/axi-todo/migrations/003_task_provenance.sql adds tasks.source (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'native') + tasks.imported_at timestamptz with COALESCE backfill from payload->>'source' / payload->>'importedAt' and reverse-sync into payload; CREATE INDEX tasks_source_idx; commit 15263c6

lib/postgres-store.mjs upsertTask writes source + imported_at (bound as task.source ?? 'native' and task.importedAt ?? null); ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE deliberately omits both columns (sticky provenance — original import timestamp preserved); payload reverse-sync writes tasks.source / tasks.imported_at back into payload on every upsert; commit 17747f9

test/store.test.mjs (+5): probe gating chosen=JSON/PG/force; upsertTask source + imported_at column binding with sticky ON CONFLICT assertion; default 'native' fallback. test/migrate-postgres.test.mjs (+6): migration parseability + idempotency + backfill + reverse-sync + payload roundtrip preservation + upsertTask structural sanity. Total: 11 new tests; full suite 144/144 (was 133). commit 60fdf48

sourceFindings: PG-NEWFINDING-1 (from M2 newFindings): M2 schema extension 把 source + importedAt 加到 JSON tasks,axi-todo-import-postgres.mjs:96 写 source: 'import-postgres',但 PG schema (001_task_memory.sql) 没对应列,migrator 写 PG 时 provenance 丢失。M4 已关闭这个 gap:003_task_provenance.sql 加 source + imported_at 列 + 幂等 backfill + reverse-sync;upsertTask 在 INSERT 路径写,ON CONFLICT 路径不动 (sticky)。

PG-NEWFINDING-2 (from M2 newFindings): warnIfDualPopulated 在 bin/axi-todo.mjs / bin/axi-todo-daemon.mjs / lib/mcp-server.mjs 三个 boot 路径上无条件探测 PG (pool.connect + readState),JSON-only 启动路径付出 PG connect 成本。M4 已收紧:chosen-side 单一时默认 skip 对侧探测,AXI_TODO_DUAL_PROBE=1 强制开启保留 M2 行为做调试。
outOfScopeButFlagged: M1 历史 10 条 JSON-only `status:'completed'` 条目 recheck:owner decision,逐条重审,不批量改状态。事实核查显示实际是 10 条而不是 18 条,本里程碑完全不涉及。
Swift AxiTodoStore 接 PG:超出 M4 scope。Swift 继续读 JSON 不变,通过 payload reverse-sync 自动透出 source / importedAt。
completion_summaries / failure_analyses / planning_records / memory_cards 加 source 列:超出 M4 scope;M4 只在 tasks 上加 source + imported_at,其他 collection 的 provenance 留后续 milestone。
warnIfDualPopulated 整体重写 / 拆分为可选的 background sync:超出 M4 scope;M4 只收紧 probe 触发条件。
PG→JSON 反向同步 (把 PG 写回到 JSON):超出 M4 scope;M2 决策 JSON canonical,PG opt-in,反向同步不在任何新Finding 里。
